item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. Work will become a choice, not a condition of survival.

2. We stand for a future where nobody owes their life to a paycheck. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. Our time will finally be ours.

3. We see a future beyond compulsory work. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We will be free to create, explore, care for one another, and live without earning our right to exist.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We mean an end to work as a requirement for survival, not an end to purpose, ambition, or contribution. We will choose how to spend our days rather than sell our time to meet our basic needs. We will create because we are curious, care because we love, and learn because discovery matters. We reject the idea that our worth depends on our employment. We stand for a future in which freedom from necessary labor belongs to everyone, and the time that makes up our lives is truly ours.
